Officer's narrative
Driver 1 was traveling in the left lane of a multi-lane roadway in Sugar Land, Texas, when Driver 2 moved from the
adjacent lane into the same space without adequate clearance. The vehicles made contact along their right and left
sides respectively, producing scraping damage consistent with a sideswipe. Driver 1 pulled to the right shoulder after
the impact. Passenger, who was seated in the front passenger position of Driver 1's vehicle, was present at the scene
and confirmed to me that they had been riding in the vehicle at the time. Driver 1 stated that they felt neck stiffness
and were epxeriencing symptoms consistent with whiplash, but it is not yet clear whether any injruy resulted from this
collision. Photographs taken at the scene confirm the position of both vehicles and the damage reported, and the
physical damage appears to match the described impact. No independent witnesses came forward. No prior damage
to Driver 1's vehicle is known to me. Driver 1 is understood to reside with the policyholder and is listed as a member
of that household. Both drivers exchanged information, and no citatoins were issued at the scene pending further
review.

- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.

- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.
